utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Good afternoon, ladies and gentlemen. Would you please call the case, Madam Registrar.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Your Honour. This is case number IT-96-23/2-I, the Prosecutor versus Gojko Jankovic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Thank you very much. May I have appearances, please. For the Prosecution?

utterances.speaker: MS. SOMERS
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Your Honour. Susan Somers for the Prosecution, assisted by Mr. Aleksandar Kontic and Mr. Sebastian van Hooydonk.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Thank you very much. For the Defence.

utterances.speaker: MR. LAZAREVIC
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Your Honour. Counsel Aleksandar Lazarevic for the accused.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Thank you very much. We will proceed with the Initial Appearance for the accused Mr. Jankovic pursuant to Rule 62 of the Rules of Procedure and Evidence. Mr. Jankovic can you hear the proceedings in a language you understand?

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Yes.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Would you please give your full name.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Gojko Jankovic, 31st of October, 1954.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Thank you. What is your address of permanent residence?

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Bosnia and Herzegovina, the town of Foca, Ivana Gorana Kovacica street, number 13.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Mr. Jankovic, have you received the indictment against you in a language that you understand, and did you have a chance to read it?

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] I received the indictment upon my arrival here, and I have read it.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Do you understand its contents, and have you had the opportunity to discuss the indictment with your counsel?

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] No, I have not had an opportunity to discuss, and I don't believe I understand the indictment fully.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Well, I believe that you have the right to plead guilty or not guilty to each count today or within 30 days from this initial appearance. Since you said that you have not had a chance to discuss with your counsel, I believe that you are not in a position today to plead at this stage. Am I right?

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] You are quite right, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Well, if -- you may sit down, please. If that is the case, we should hold another initial appearance within 30 days from today. And at this stage are there any other matters the parties would like to bring to the attention? Yes, Ms. Somers.

utterances.speaker: MS. SOMERS
utterances.text: Thank you very much, Your Honour. The Prosecution would like to bring to Your Honour's attention that the accused is the subject of a motion for referral under Rule 11 bis. It was filed 29 November 2004, and as a result, the Prosecution yesterday filed an additional motion to suspend all non-essential proceedings. It should -- hopefully should reach Your Honour and you should have a chance to peruse it when it comes to you, but I wanted to make sure you were aware of this. Thank you, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Well, did the Defence receive this filing by the Prosecution?

utterances.speaker: MR. LAZAREVIC
utterances.text: Yes, Your Honour. What I can confirm is that I have just received this Prosecutor motion to suspend all non-essential proceedings, dated March 17, 2005, but in relation to the motion for referral under Rule 11 bis, this one I still haven't received. Then further, there is also the issue that I am assigned only for the initial appearance of the accused, and the Registry will deal with this situation and decide whether I will be his permanent counsel or not. So I will be in contact with the Prosecution as well as other issues here will be related consequently.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Thank you very much. As for the filings by the Prosecution to suspend all non-essential proceedings, I don't believe I'm in a position to deal with it right now, because we should have the initial appearance and the plea first, and later on I believe that I'll be in a better position to deal with it.

utterances.speaker: MS. SOMERS
utterances.text: Thank you, Your Honour. I just wanted to make sure it was brought to your attention. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Thank you. Are there any other matters? It seems to me there is none, so I believe that this initial appearance is adjourned.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: at 2.28 p.m.
